resources.string: Piko Tor (experimental)
Experimental build — not yet validated for leak prevention on Android. Do not use for sensitive activity. Tor does not hide your logged-in X account identity.
Choose the patched X app
Confirm app identity
Associate this app

Package: %1$s
Signing certificate SHA-256:
%2$s

Confirm this is your patched X installation. Re-signing or replacing the app requires confirmation again. This does not authenticate the original X publisher.
Associated app: %1$s
No trusted target. Associate the installed patched X app with a different Android UID.
Prepare VPN and start Tor
Open Android VPN settings

Only one VPN can run per Android profile. If you already use a VPN, keep it active unless you deliberately choose to replace it with Piko Tor. Android may hide VPNs that exclude this app; accepting its VPN permission can replace your existing VPN.\n\nFirst consent to the VPN, then enable Always-on VPN and Block connections without VPN for Piko Tor in Android settings. Tor will not start until both are detected. Do not use X during setup. Other apps in this profile may lose Internet access; consider a dedicated profile for X. A tunnel alone is not a kill switch.
Another VPN is active

Piko Tor has not started or replaced your VPN. Android allows one VPN per profile. Keep your current VPN, or open Android VPN settings to choose which provider you want to use. Piko Tor does not send X through Tor while another provider is selected.
VPN permission changed before Piko Tor could start. Your selected VPN has not been replaced by this action. Check Android VPN settings before trying again.
Retry Tor / refresh circuits
Stop Piko Tor

Stopping closes this tunnel. Android lockdown is NOT disabled by this action: keep it on to block X. If you disable lockdown, revoke VPN permission or uninstall Piko Tor, X may connect directly and reveal your IP. Android may restart an always-on VPN.
Stop the VPN before changing the associated app. Keep Android lockdown enabled.
Start the VPN first.
Android could not start the service. Check VPN consent and system settings. Protection is not verified.
Service stopped — protection not verified.
VPN unavailable — protection lost or unverified. Only Android lockdown can block traffic without the tunnel.
Tunnel present; Tor paused. Enable Always-on VPN AND Block connections without VPN.
Strict Private DNS is unsupported in this milestone. Tor paused; the tunnel is retained.
No underlying Internet network detected — tunnel retained.
Tunnel and Android lockdown detected — connecting to Tor.
Tor unavailable — tunnel retained, no direct fallback configured.
Tor reports ready; tunnel and Android lockdown detected. End-to-end protection has NOT been validated.
